description: Defines the interface and data structures for device driver management in a device service framework, including callback function types, device driver struct, and communication with device service.

methods.name: deviceFound
methods.description: Callback to notify device discovery with details and acceptance status.

methods.name: getDevicesByDeviceDriver
methods.description: Retrieve list of devices associated with a specific device driver.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieve a device object by its UUID.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieve an endpoint object for a device by device UUID and endpoint ID.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Retrieve a resource object for a device by device UUID, endpoint ID, and resource ID.

methods.name: updateResource
methods.description: Update a device resource, persist change, and optionally trigger an event.

methods.name: setMetadata
methods.description: Set metadata key-value pair for a device endpoint.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Get metadata value for a device endpoint by name.

methods.name: removeDevice
methods.description: Remove a device from inventory by UUID.

methods.name: discoverStart
methods.description: Start device discovery for specified device classes with timeout.

methods.name: discoverStop
methods.description: Stop device discovery for specified device classes.

methods.name: addEndpoint
methods.description: Add an endpoint to an existing device and persist changes.

methods.name: enableEndpoint
methods.description: Enable and persist an endpoint on a device.
